destination.title: Axion origin, strong CP and quality
destination.question: Which microscopic constructions produce QCD axions or other light pseudoscalars, and under what conditions do QCD candidates retain strong-CP relaxation and sufficient quality?
destination.summary: Compare construction and protection mechanisms while retaining their distinct field content, symmetry structure and quality criteria.

targets: Strong-CP relaxation and accompanying particle sectors
regimes: Source-specific compactifications, strong sectors and effective theories
assumptions: A construction is assessed under its stated microscopic assumptions
An additional light axion need not solve strong CP
conventions: Residual strong CP and preservation of the usual QCD mass relation are separately specified quality targets
includes: Joint Higgs, neutrino and baryogenesis model-building targets
excludes: A shared mass–coupling relation for every axion

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Can scalar-free strong dynamics unify the Higgs and QCD axion as composite pseudo-Nambu–Goldstone bosons at Λ ∼ 10^11 GeV, while accommodating fermion masses, a small high-scale Higgs quartic and potentially gauge-coupling unification?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Does a gravitationally generated axion harmonic preserve the QCD axion's cancellation of strong CP? The reviewed model compares a QCD cosine minimized at zero with a second cosine of the same period and a generic relative phase.

sources.title: A Holographic Perspective on the Axion Quality Problem

evidence.text: Can a holographic composite axion retain its QCD coupling while sufficiently suppressing gravitational PQ violation through separation between an IR-localized axion and UV sources of explicit breaking?

sources.title: A common origin for the QCD axion and sterile neutrinos from $SU(5)$ strong dynamics

evidence.text: Can one chiral strong sector provide a high-quality composite QCD axion and sterile neutrinos, connecting PQ breaking to active-neutrino masses through either heavy composite states or light elementary–composite mixtures?

sources.title: Axion Quality in Warped Extra-Dimension

evidence.text: How do warping, orbifold boundary conditions, and fixed-point interactions control non-QCD potentials of a Wilson-line QCD axion? The stated natural quality target is VHE≲10⁻¹⁰mπ²fπ² for generic misalignment of the non-QCD minimum.

sources.title: Axions In String Theory

evidence.text: Which string compactifications yield an axion coupling scale compatible with conventional cosmology, while sufficiently suppressing non-QCD violations of its Peccei–Quinn symmetry?

sources.title: Axions and the strong CP problem in M theory

evidence.text: Under what compactification and hidden-sector conditions can string axions solve strong CP in the M-theory limit, with non-QCD PQ breaking satisfying δV ≲ 10^-9 fπ²mπ² ≈ 10^-13 GeV⁴, while remaining phenomenologically and cosmologically viable?

sources.title: Protecting the Axion with Local Baryon Number

evidence.text: Can gauged baryon number protect an accidental PQ symmetry from dangerous Planck-suppressed operators while its anomaly-canceling exotic fermions implement the KSVZ hidden-axion mechanism?

sources.title: Peccei-Quinn symmetry with residual symmetries

evidence.text: Can a PQ symmetry with residual discrete subgroups produce an invisible axion from low, potentially TeV-scale scalar VEVs, suppressing its fermion couplings while avoiding the Higgs-portal tuning associated with a very high symmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: Axion from pseudo Goldstone seesaw without Peccei-Quinn symmetry

evidence.text: The historical manuscript asks whether tiny mixing between heavy and ultralight pseudo-Goldstone bosons could produce an axion without an anomalous Peccei–Quinn global symmetry, while keeping symmetry-breaking scales near TeV.

sources.title: High-Quality Axion Models with the Anomalous $U(1)_X$ Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: Can an anomalous gauged U(1)X protect an accidental Peccei–Quinn symmetry against dangerous Planck-suppressed operators using only two vector-like pairs, while permitting anomaly cancellation and approximate gauge coupling unification?

sources.title: GeV-scale QCD Axion

evidence.text: Can Peccei–Quinn breaking below the QCD scale solve strong CP while allowing a GeV-scale axion, avoiding existing constraints and producing observable hadronic or ultraviolet-completion signatures?

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Coset NGB matrices and Yukawa spurions organize gauge and four-fermion contributions to the potential. The appendix estimates leading quark-loop potentials and expands them to identify Higgs and σHuHd interactions.

sources.title: Protecting the Axion with Local Baryon Number

evidence.text: Finds the lowest gauge-invariant scalar monomial that violates the anomalous global symmetry, then estimates its Planck-suppressed contribution to θ̄. The analysis prioritizes operators made from scalars with large VEVs.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Derive the reparametrization constraint, reinterpret its solution as a field, and introduce interactions representing topology change. This supplies a dynamical alternative to simply integrating static α parameters.

sources.title: A Holographic Perspective on the Axion Quality Problem

evidence.text: The authors derive coupled pseudoscalar equations and gauge-compatible boundary conditions, expand a and Vz in the same 4D KK modes, and use χ=∂za−Vz and a gauge-fixing combination ζ to solve the massless sector with modified Bessel functions.

sources.title: Peccei-Quinn symmetry with residual symmetries

evidence.text: In the DFSZ construction, remove the three Goldstone modes eaten by W± and Z, identify the remaining axion direction, and project its couplings onto SM quark axial currents. Higgs-portal effects are estimated by inserting singlet VEVs into the scalar potential.

sources.title: Axion from pseudo Goldstone seesaw without Peccei-Quinn symmetry

evidence.text: Removes scalar phases from fermion masses by chiral field redefinitions, integrates derivative-current terms by parts, and invokes the axial triangle anomaly to infer gluon and photon couplings. These are manuscript calculations around its assumed vacuum.

sources.title: Strong-$CP$ with and without gravity

evidence.text: Does coupling QCD to gravity turn strong CP from a naturalness puzzle into a consistency condition requiring an exact axion mechanism, and can a gauge formulation protect that mechanism without a global Peccei–Quinn symmetry?

sources.title: Irrational axions as a solution of the strong CP problem in an eternal universe

evidence.text: Can an irrationally coupled heavy axion screen the QCD θ angle without a massless particle, and can the resulting vacuum selection operate in a universe that has been cool for only a finite time?

sources.title: Impact of First-order Electroweak Phase Transition on QCD Axion

evidence.text: Can a temporary axion-mass contribution associated with a first-order electroweak transition change misalignment dynamics enough to obtain QCD-axion dark matter over a wider decay-constant range, while producing a potentially detectable gravitational-wave signal?

sources.title: Axions, strong and weak CP, and KNP inflation

evidence.text: How do pseudoscalars, approximate global symmetries and underlying discrete gauge symmetries enter the QCD axion, strong and weak CP violation, dark-sector cosmology and KNP inflation?

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: The QCD axion dynamically relaxes the strong CP angle. The paper asks whether the periodic potential needed for this mechanism is compatible with a derivative bound on the full potential when quintessence is its only light spectator.

sources.title: Technically Natural Baryogenesis with the QCD Axion

evidence.text: Can QCD-axion dynamics account simultaneously for strong CP relaxation, the baryon asymmetry and dark matter using technically natural ingredients, while preserving axion quality and avoiding excessive relic abundance?

sources.title: Gravity, Superselection Rules and Axions

evidence.text: Can coupling to quantum gravity turn a superselection parameter into a local field's vacuum expectation value? The proposed example is the QCD θ parameter and its promotion to an axion.

sources.title: Emergent/Composite axions

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector instanton densities, coupled to the Standard Model through heavy messengers, generate emergent axions, and when can their masses, interactions and dynamics support a QCD axion or other cosmological roles?

sources.title: Leading logs in QCD axion effective field theory

evidence.text: When does identifying the ultraviolet cutoff of a logarithmically divergent axion EFT loop with f_a reproduce a complete QCD axion model, particularly for K⁺→π⁺a? Can a renormalizable model realize the large logarithm without additional states below the PQ scale?

sources.title: Axions in the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can a QCD axion solving the strong CP problem satisfy observations in a theory with one micron-scale extra dimension, and how do its predictions differ between localization on the Standard Model brane and propagation in the five-dimensional bulk?

sources.title: Extra-dimensional axion expectations

evidence.text: What would measuring an extra-dimensional axion decay constant reveal about axion string tensions and the fundamental quantum-gravity cutoff, and how does this scenario differ phenomenologically from four-dimensional PQ models?

sources.title: String Axiverse

evidence.text: Conditional on a string QCD axion solving strong CP naturally, should many additional ultralight axions exist, and how could cosmological observations and rotating black holes reveal their masses and couplings?

sources.title: High-quality Axion Strings from Monopole Strings

evidence.text: Can extra-dimensional Wilson-line axions retain high quality while acquiring solitonic strings with tensions parametrically below quantum gravity, enabling post-inflationary axion dark matter?

sources.title: String compactification, QCD axion and axion-photon-photon coupling

evidence.text: Can a phenomenologically viable heterotic compactification supply a QCD axion with an experimentally accessible decay constant, after imposing realistic Yukawa couplings, hidden-sector confinement and axion mixing? What axion-photon-photon coupling follows?

sources.title: Axions in string theory — slaying the Hydra of dark radiation

evidence.text: Can a high-quality closed-string QCD axion coexist with inflation, reheating and acceptable axionic dark radiation in an LVS cosmology?

sources.title: UV and IR effects in axion quality control

evidence.text: How does the higher-dimensional form-field origin of axions change their UV sensitivity, the QCD axion quality problem, and the relation between decay constants and observable matter couplings? Quality includes both maintaining a sufficiently small effective strong-CP angle and preserving the usual QCD-generated axion mass relation.

sources.title: Axion theory and model building

evidence.text: How does the ultraviolet origin of QCD axions and lighter axion-like particles determine their low-energy couplings, and could measured masses and couplings distinguish those origins?

sources.title: Axionic domain wall number related to U(1)$_{\rm anom}$ global symmetry

evidence.text: Can an intermediate-scale QCD axion inherited from an anomalous string U(1) simultaneously address gravitational spoil of PQ symmetry and the cosmological domain-wall problem, despite an apparently large anomaly-related vacuum multiplicity?

sources.title: Exploring CP violation beyond the Standard Model and the PQ quality with electric dipole moments

evidence.text: Can nucleon, nuclear and atomic EDM patterns distinguish light-quark or gluon CEDMs from the QCD θ-term, with and without the PQ mechanism, and identify whether the axion vacuum value originates from CEDMs or additional UV PQ breaking?

sources.title: A step in flux to suppress axion isocurvature

evidence.text: Can a quantized axion mass switch from large during inflation to exactly zero afterward, relaxing pre-inflation QCD axion isocurvature constraints while preserving late-time strong-CP relaxation and misalignment dark matter?

sources.title: String theory and grand unification suggest a submicroelectronvolt QCD axion

evidence.text: How strongly do grand unification and proton stability constrain the QCD axion mass when the axion descends from a higher-dimensional gauge field?

sources.title: The quality/cosmology tension for a post-inflation QCD axion

evidence.text: Can a post-inflation QCD axion simultaneously solve the quality problem, eliminate domain walls, and avoid unacceptable relics and low Standard Model Landau poles, while retaining conventional axion dark-matter predictions?

sources.title: A scaling non-compact QCD axion

evidence.text: Can a runaway exponential potential dynamically erase inflationary QCD-axion isocurvature before QCD, while yielding viable dark matter and acceptable residual strong-CP violation?

sources.title: Removing the Cosmological Bound on the Axion Scale via Confinement During Inflation

evidence.text: Can an inflationary epoch of high-scale confinement implement early axion relaxation in SU(5), suppressing later coherent misalignment enough to remove the conventional cosmological upper bound on today's axion decay constant in KSVZ, DFSZ and gauge-axion realizations?

sources.title: Precision axion physics with running axion couplings

evidence.text: Can precision measurements of photon, nucleon and electron couplings distinguish light string-theoretic axions from KSVZ-like and DFSZ-like axions after RG evolution, including a possible supersymmetric extension below the axion decay constant?

sources.title: Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities

evidence.text: Can the axion endpoint prescription be derived beyond specific string constructions, and does it survive explicit nonperturbative shift breaking? Can running theta be constrained in QCD-like theories or supply useful vacuum branches in self-tuning models?

sources.title: Axions and ALPs: a very short introduction

evidence.text: How do the QCD axion and more general axion-like particles arise, acquire masses and Standard Model couplings, populate the Universe, and produce observable particle or gravitational signatures? This is a short pedagogical review.

sources.title: Gauge Coupling Jump and Small Instantons from a Large Nonminimal Coupling

evidence.text: Can a large scalar nonminimal coupling generate gauge-coupling thresholds and enhanced small instantons, changing QCD axion quality, mass and inflationary cosmology?

sources.title: Search for QCD Axions in light of String Theory

evidence.text: Can string compactification and dark dimension arguments narrow the QCD axion decay constant enough to motivate targeted searches using hydrogen atomic transitions or laboratory laser interferometry?

sources.title: Efficient approach to low scale Peccei-Quinn symmetry breaking without domain wall problem

evidence.text: Can an economical extension of the Standard Model produce an invisible QCD axion while breaking physical PQ symmetry far below the usual axion decay-constant scale, potentially near the weak scale, without a domain-wall problem?

sources.title: Strong <math display="inline"><mi>C</mi><mi>P</mi></math> problem and its gauge axion solution as evidence for fundamental strings

evidence.text: How does QCD topological susceptibility establish the physicality of θ, how can a gauge two-form eliminate θ-vacua with exact axion quality, and does its string–wall structure imply fundamental strings?

sources.title: Dark energy, QCD axion, BICEP2, and trans-Planckian decay constant

evidence.text: Can approximate global symmetries descending from string-compatible discrete symmetries account for dark energy, QCD-axion dark matter and inflation, including a trans-Planckian effective decay constant?

sources.title: Axion strings from string axions

evidence.text: Can a gauge-protected axion in a warped extra dimension form a cosmological string network despite having no explicit PQ scalar, and how do its string profile, tension and first-order formation mechanism affect expectations for axion dark matter?

sources.title: Testing F-theory GUTs with the Axiverse

evidence.text: Does the QCD-axion-like bound on photon coupling divided by mass survive F-theory GUT breaking by hypercharge flux, which introduces photon-coupled axions without gluon couplings?

sources.title: Supersymmetry, axions and cosmology

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric axion partners change cosmological bounds on the QCD axion decay constant, and when do generic light pseudoscalar moduli create additional cosmological problems?

sources.title: Ultralight axion in supersymmetry and strings and cosmology at small scales

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric and string models generate a non-QCD axion of mass 10^-21–10^-22 eV through the electroweak hierarchy, while accommodating moduli stabilization, a viable weak scale and dark matter production?

sources.title: Opening the 1$\,$Hz axion window

evidence.text: Can an M-theory-inspired ultralight axion supply all dark matter while a separate QCD axion solves strong CP, without the usual overproduction at GUT-scale decay constants, and with testable couplings or residual CP violation?

sources.title: Heterotic String Theory Suggests a QCD Axion Near 0.5 neV

evidence.text: Does the heterotic model-independent axion impose a QCD-axion mass floor near 0.5 neV, how often can model-dependent axions shift that mass, and are the resulting PQ quality and heavy-axion cosmology viable?

sources.title: Diluting the inflationary axion fluctuation by a stronger QCD in the early Universe
